name: Kokubyaku no Avesta
source:
Under the world of the first Divine Throne, two forces are killing each other relentlessly. Black and White, Light and Darkness, Good and Evil. Until the other is destroyed, the fighting will never stop. That is the instinct called Avesta.

Following the wicked warrior [url=https://vndb.org/c111533]Magsarion[/url] and his path of remorseless breaking dualism, along with [url=https://vndb.org/c111534]Quinn[/url], who is tasked with collecting a "miracle".

[from [url=https://shinzabansho.fandom.com/wiki/Avesta_of_Black_and_White] Shinza Bansho wiki[/url]]
translation:
第一神王座的世界之下，两股势力正在无情地互相厮杀。黑与白，光明与黑暗，善与恶。在对方被消灭之前，战斗永远不会停止。这就是被称为阿维斯塔的本能。

跟随邪恶的战士 [url=https://vndb.org/c111533]Magsarion[/url] 和他无情地打破二元论的道路，以及肩负收集“奇迹”任务的 [url=https://vndb.org/c111534]Quinn[/url]。

[来自[url=https://shinzabansho.fandom.com/wiki/Avesta_of_Black_and_White] Shinza Bansho wiki[/url]]
